method: python training/confirm_content_answers.py --data-dir ml-32m Why this test exists: training/evaluate_blends.py showed content did not beat fans alone when it only saw 3 liked movies. But in the app, content is also the only model that reads your Step 2 answers (the genres you pick). MovieLens has no Step 2 answers, so that job was never tested. This test simulates it. The earlier result stays reported in the README either way. Setup (same MovieLens 32M 1-in-5 sample and time split as evaluate_blends.py, fresh viewers): - 3,000 viewers drawn with a new seed (53) and none of the viewers evaluate_blends.py used. - The app sees 3 random liked movies, exactly as before. - Simulated Step 2 answer: the viewer's 2 most-liked genres across their whole TRAINING history (what a   person knows about their own taste). Their held-out future loves are never used to build the answer. - Content score = similarity to the 3 likes plus similarity to the stated genres, through the same   TF-IDF + SVD model the app uses. Fans = the app's shipped "viewers like you" ranking. - A = fans alone. B = 80% fans + 20% content (the app's real mix).
